blocks.text: It is the lowest region of the atmosphere which extends up to 12 km. It includes all the major gases present in the atmosphere i.e., nitrogen, oxygen, and carbon-dioxide, etc. In this region, temperature decreases from 17 °C to -58 °C regularly. It is the densest layer of the atmosphere. It is the layer in which major events such as rain, lightning, and hurricanes occur.

blocks.alt: Part of the curved Earth at the lower right under a blue sky. A long diagonal line runs up from near the Earth, crossed by four leader lines that join a height to a layer name: 0-12 km Troposphere, 12-50 km Stratosphere, 50-80 km Mesosphere and 80-600 km Thermosphere.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.1: Layers of the atmosphere (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 14.1).
